blocks.html:
Motorcycle Wrap

Summer is almost here. Are you looking to get out onto the road? As the weather improves, we are starting to see more bikers on the road. Vinyl Wrap Toronto has also noticed an increase in the number of inquiries about bike wraps as Summer approaches. Now is the time to think about a change of colour, adding decals, or maybe changing up the feel with a carbon fibre vinyl wrap.

We specialize in tank wraps, adding decals or stickers, and full wraps. Vinyl Wrap Toronto mainly uses 3M and Avery Dennison vinyl, Click here to learn more.
We love wrapping bikes as much as we love seeing the happy clients’ faces when they first see the completed wrap. Call and speak to one of our crew at 416-746-1381 for a quote today.

If you know your way around your bike and are budget conscious, we suggest removing the parts you want to be wrapped before dropping them off with us. This will not only save you money, but it will also mean the turnaround time to get your motorcycle wrapped will the quicker. If you would prefer, our installation crew has rebuilt many a car and bike over the years so you can leave it to us with confidence.

These three full motorcycle wraps were done last spring/summer ready to be enjoyed. Why not speak to our designers about wrapping your bike today? Visit our 3300 sq ft facility at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke to pick your colours and finish.
Like us on Facebook, Follow us on Instagram, Heart us on Twitter, and add a Comment on Pinterest.
